description: Incremental clicking game where you click a big cookie to earn cookies and buy upgrades
vlm_prompts: You are playing Cookie Clicker. Your goal is to maximize cookie production by clicking the big cookie and purchasing upgrades.
Available actions: click the big cookie repeatedly, buy cursor upgrades to automate clicking, buy grandma upgrades for passive production, check your cookies per second (CPS) progress.
Strategy: Start by clicking manually, then buy cursor upgrades when affordable. Monitor your CPS and decide when to switch from manual clicking to buying production upgrades.
